spec.body_markdown: ## Dot Product\n\nThe dot product A . B = |A||B|cos(theta) measures how much of B points along A. In components, A . B = AxBx + AyBy. It's zero for perpendicular vectors and maximal (|A||B|) for parallel ones. Work = Force . Displacement is a classic physics example.
